content_sections.heading: Police Commissionerate Bhubaneswar Kataka Special Police Officer (SPO) Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises document verification, a medical test, a physical test, and an interview. Candidates shall be put through a medical test to check physical fitness. Persons with physical deformities shall not be eligible for appointment. Candidates should be physically fit and mentally alert. They must cover a distance of 5 (five) Kilometers on foot within a period of one hour. Candidates who qualify in the medical test and physical test will appear before the Selection Board for interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Two recent passport-size self-attested photographs. Self-attested copies of certificates in support of age and qualification. Self-attested copy of discharge certificate. Two-character certificates attested by two different Group-B Gazetted Officers.
